scope: Previously checksum-only frozen image identities recovered from the thirteen surviving verified archive copies; this supplement does not mutate the frozen catalog or grant visual/artistic acceptance.

methods.raster_method: Verify encoded image integrity, reopen encoded bytes, seek and load every frame; no image output or creative transformation written.
methods.prior_validation_reuse: Only exact SHA256 and compatible byte size; archive and member bytes independently matched the frozen receipts.
methods.svg_method: Checksum and ZIP CRC only; SVG is unsupported by Pillow, CairoSVG is not installed, and no alternate SVG renderer was invoked.
